'''The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game''' is the 6th Star Wars CCG product, published March 1997. It contains eight premium cards (7 exclusive white-border plus a white-border Jedi Pack Leia), two 60-card preconstructed decks, a rules booklet, a sample-game booklet (not in early boxes), and one Premiere booster. MSRP $19.95. White-border Hoth/ANH/Premiere cards in the decks use a © 1996 date, unlike Revised Hoth. Japanese version by Takara.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
